research.notes: This vendor entry is a composite of two separate organizations, not one: (1) Northern California ReLiEF (NCR), a public-school risk-sharing joint powers authority administered by Keenan (Torrance, CA), and (2) Public Risk Innovation, Solutions, and Management (PRISM; the agenda spells it 'PRISIM'), a public-agency risk pool headquartered in Folsom, CA (formerly EIA). Both are plausible matches for OUSD's 'Workers' Compensation Coverage and Excess Property and Liability Coverage' premiums, but a single About box would be wrong for one of them. Registry and official pages were not fetchable (reliefjpa.org returned only a title; prismrisk.gov returned 403), so no field could be verified. Recommend splitting into two vendor entries (via the manual alias table or a name-split rule) and researching each separately.
